review_coverage: Read the frozen wrapper, its spec/review and verify_process_chain before reviewing the complete launcher, tests and final spec.
Default check-only mode; explicit one-shot execute flag; fixed wrapper command and stage=test inherited from the frozen wrapper; no alternate science path, retry or automatic resume.
Externally pinned real runtime review, audit2025 SHA, independent launcher review and exact publication scope; reuse of frozen admit for validation models/freeze/authorities/checkpoints.
Exact local Git object verification at an externally supplied 40-hex commit; remote publication remains a separate coordinator obligation, with unrelated changes preserved.
New disjoint output/log roots, consistent path normalization, decimal 2GB RAM/commit gate immediately before Popen and original inherited environment.
Original Popen handle retained for GetProcessTimes, WaitForSingleObject and GetExitCodeProcess; actual integer exit, no PID-absence inference, no termination/relaunch.

Process receipt chain binds PID, creation time, command, process_binding SHA and the published monitor-code pin; compatibility with the frozen verify_process_chain for future externally reviewed resume.
Post-spawn constructor/write/interruption failure handling drains the original Popen if necessary and does not fabricate a complete Win32 observation chain.
Monitor code and opening/binding receipts rechecked at closure; exit0 is explicitly separate from scientific completion, economic audit and promotion.

findings.problem: Preflight normalized roots but launch compared the original JSON path strings to normalized Windows strings.
findings.resolution: Launch compares roots after overlay.absolute normalization.
findings.independent_evidence: Equivalent slash/backslash roots pass preflight and synthetic execute.

findings.problem: RetainedProcess initialization was outside the protected post-Popen path; observer/log failures could abandon supervision.
findings.resolution: Monitor construction is inside the try; failures drain the original Popen via wait without retry or invented observation receipts. Failed interruption logging does not abandon the retained handle.
findings.independent_evidence: Reran constructor-failure and failed-interruption-log fixtures. Read the storage/admission failure cleanup paths and the author's full-suite evidence.

findings.problem: The initial publication scope included the wrapper/scientific reviews but not the launcher's own independent review.
findings.resolution: launch_binding.launcher_review now requires an external path/SHA for this fixed-name JSON, exact CLEAR/IMPLEMENTATION_ONLY/runtime=false fields and the three code hashes. It is included in published_files and Git object checks.
findings.independent_evidence: Reran wrong-review-hash, wrong-decision and wrong-files fixtures.

findings.problem: A late sha(__file__) could assign different disk bytes as the monitor authority after preflight.
findings.resolution: Monitor SHA is taken from the external preflight publication pin and rechecked before opening and at closure, together with process_binding/monitor_open hashes.
findings.independent_evidence: Reran mutation-at-opening and mutation-at-closing fixtures; neither produces a falsely complete process chain.

pytest_arguments: retained_receipts or resource_drop or resource_boundaries or native_monitor_initialization or failed_interruption or monitor_code_mutation or equivalent_root or launcher_review or native_fast or frozen_wrapper
independent_validation.synthetic_chain_checks: Full synthetic receipts for exit0/7 passed the real frozen verify_process_chain(validation=False); Popen/source authorities were doubles in these cases.
independent_validation.native_handle_checks: Three harmless real Windows Python children exited immediately with 0, 7 and 259. GetProcessTimes and the signalled-handle exit query used the retained original Popen handle, including after child.wait had already observed termination.
independent_validation.evidence_location: Observed tool output in this session; temporary fixture artifacts are not real runtime evidence.

publication_boundary.local_git_verification_scope: Exact bytes of all publication members and runtime-review at the external commit; no requirement for unrelated working-tree changes or later unrelated HEAD commits to be absent.
publication_boundary.remote_publication_obligation: Root verifies and documents actual remote publication before execution; cached refs/local objects alone do not establish it.

required_before_execution: Complete validation2025, preserve its selected mode/null and 24 models, and obtain its actual retained-handle exit0 evidence.
Complete independent audit2025 and fix its actual SHA externally.
Review and publish the concrete wrapper runtime binding, including launch_binding roots, this review's external SHA and the exact publication map.
Root verifies remote publication and coordinates the fresh RAM/commit gate before the explicit one-shot execute option.
